scope: Natural, passive, front-door correlations against the already-running F1 Challenge Online.exe process. No input, process-memory write, asset change, restart, forced pit call, debugger, or injector was used.
evidence_tier: OBSERVED where a value comes from the preserved correlation artifacts; interpretations are marked separately.

service_interval_seconds.definition: sampled timestamp difference from PitStatus 2_to_3 to 3_to_4

fuel_level_derived_delta_over_matched_se.limitation: FuelLevelDerived retains its existing DERIVED tier; this is a field-value correlation, not a unit or rate claim.

tire_choice.limitation: No conclusion about physical tyre work follows from a stable TireChoice value.

unclassified_2_to_0.interpretation: No sampled status-3 event; classify only as a natural sampled return from 2 to 0.

job_field_context.PitRefuelFlag: observed as 1 at captured natural-stop transitions
job_field_context.PitTyreChangeFlag: observed as 1 at captured natural-stop transitions
job_field_context.PitWingChangeFlag: observed as 0 at captured natural-stop transitions
job_field_context.PitRepairFlag: two 1_to_0 events, sampled while PitStatus was 3, slots 11 and 17

two_hz_combined_observed.limitation: At 2 Hz, direct 0_to_2 and 2_to_4 samples can skip an intermediate state. They do not prove a different state-machine path or replace the 5 Hz timing evidence.

non_claims: No observed field is authorized as a write input.
PitTeamIndex does not by itself identify a physical stall or allocation policy.
ActivePitCrewSetPtr does not by itself prove crew activity.
The job-field labels remain correlation targets; the capture does not establish a human-readable repair or tyre-work taxonomy.
